title: Flash Photos Not Timed Right
text: At first I thought maybe it was my phone and was going to reach out to Apple when I was trying to take some “scans” and every time the flash would fire to remove the shadows on my pages, the “scan” would have the shadows. Then I tried the same scenario of taking photos of my pages with the camera app and had no issue at all with shadows. Leads me to believe that the app is responsible in some way for the shutter and flash not syncing with the scans. Is this a known bug? Is a fix coming? iPhone 14 Pro running iOS 17.3.1
